title: Season novelty by frequency
principle: The more often an action is performed, the less rewarding novel motion becomes. Make most things familiar; do something unexpected where intent allows.
procedure: Classify actions: high / medium / low frequency.
Strip novel motion from high-frequency paths.
Reserve novelty for moments users seek delight or first-run wonder.
Check intent: games tolerate more novelty than banking.
Re-review after launch—novelty decays with exposure.
examplePrompts:
